title: Rewiring Preserves Fan-In Two
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $N$ inputs, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose the source list has length $N$, each source index is less than $k+2$, and every gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs. Then the circuit obtained by rewiring $C$ using those sources, with two additional constant inputs $0$ and $1$, has distinct input vertices at every gate, exactly one input at each NOT gate, and at most two inputs at every gate.
